name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B Q4_K_M
why: The contributor entry point. Its weights are a single public download — no conversion, no quantization, no 88 GB of transient disk. That is the whole reason it exists: the arena's first target needed a checkpoint nobody could fetch, which put hours of work in front of anyone's first line of CUDA.

weights.verifiedHow: HF API: gated=False, private=False, and the file is listed in the repo.

serveArgsNote: Stock llama.cpp flags — this model needs no architecture port, unlike laguna. THINKING IS DISABLED VIA extraBody, NOT via --reasoning-budget 0: measured on build b9902-7ad9bd259, that flag leaves Qwen3.6 emitting an empty `content` with the whole output budget spent in `reasoning_content`. `chat_template_kwargs: {enable_thinking: false}` in the request body works — content 'Hello', finish_reason 'stop'. The flag does work for Laguna, so this is per-model, not per-build. --parallel 1 is appended by the harness from the contract, because any batching breaks token identity on this part.

modelIntegrity.shaNote: Size is checked every run. Full hashing is opt-in because it costs ~1 min; the referee turns it on.

expectedKernels: mmid.cu / topk-moe.cu / add-id.cu -- MoE routing; should NOT move a dense target
rope.cu / norm.cu / softmax.cu / cpy.cu -- engine-general; should move EVERY target
blastRadiusNote: Same quant family as the laguna target (Q4_K_M MoE), so this pair does NOT yet give blast-radius power. A deliberately different third target -- dense, or a different quant -- is still wanted; chunk 04.
